settings.paragraph: What technologies do you use for custom website development?

Most business websites are built on WordPress, with Shopify or WooCommerce for online stores. For complex websites and web portals we use HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Angular and Vue.js on the front end, PHP, Python and Node.js on the back end, and MySQL, PostgreSQL or MongoDB databases — we recommend what suits your project best.
Can you develop a website with custom functionality or integrations?

Yes. We build custom features and integrate payment gateways, CRMs, ERPs, booking systems, multi-language support and third-party APIs. Tell us what you need and we’ll recommend the right approach and quote it before we start.
